baseline.equivalence_test: all selectors receive identical one-shot Top-50 candidates and scorer values

core_invariants: Freeze nq_open validation, the five predeclared sample positions, Wiki-DPR retrieval, Answer Scorer, Generator, evaluator, and answer labels.
Retrieve exactly once per question and pass the same Top-50 embeddings, texts, metadata, and Answer Scorer scores to every selector.
Selector outputs are observation-only; no case-study result, gold answer, or generated prediction reaches retrieval or selection.
Preserve each selector's returned Top-5 order when calling the frozen Generator.
Complete case-study files remain exchange-only; GitHub receives only compact provenance and upload metadata.

interfaces.output_schema: one shared Top-50 list with id, title, text, rank, retrieval score, and Answer Scorer score
invariants: same candidate list for all selectors

interfaces.input_schema: shared query embedding, Top-50 passage embeddings/texts, and scorer scores
interfaces.output_schema: allowlisted selector Top-5 records in returned order

interfaces.input_schema: question and one selector's ordered Top-5 context
interfaces.output_schema: prediction and EM/F1 plus answer-string-in-text proxy flags
invariants: same frozen Generator for every selector
proxy flags are not strict gold passage labels

interfaces.output_schema: human Markdown, machine JSON, and compact hash manifest
invariants: raw content never enters compact files
hashes computed after complete files are closed

plugins.insertion_point: after query encoding and before selector calls
plugins.hypothesis: A shared candidate pool is required for an interpretable selector case study.
plugins.input_schema: fixed NQ-Open questions and Wiki-DPR index
plugins.output_schema: Top-50 records with global Wiki-DPR ids and full text
failure_signatures: candidate ids or ranks differ between selectors

plugins.hypothesis: Case-level differences among QORE and established baselines expose selection mechanisms on identical evidence.
plugins.input_schema: shared Top-50 embeddings, texts, and scorer values
plugins.output_schema: five unique selected passage records per allowlisted method

plugins.hypothesis: The same selected passage can produce different answer behavior across selectors and reveals answer-realization failure modes.
plugins.output_schema: raw prediction, EM/F1, and explicitly labelled answer-string proxy diagnostics
plugins.resource_estimate: one greedy generation per selector and question

plugins.insertion_point: after all in-memory generations and evaluations
plugins.hypothesis: A content-complete private artifact makes mechanism inspection possible without leaking raw data to GitHub.
plugins.input_schema: complete case records and runtime provenance

composition.merge_rule: One shared retrieval/scorer result is fanned out to the explicit selector allowlist; each returned Top-5 is sent to the same frozen Generator.
interaction_ablations: QORE versus top-k on identical candidate ranks
QORE versus diversity baselines on identical scorer values
selected passage-set intersection and symmetric differences
answer-string proxy flags versus generated EM/F1

validation.baseline_equivalence: Candidate ids, texts, embeddings, and scorer scores are byte-equivalent inputs across selector arms.
tests: fixed slice and selector allowlist contract
shared candidate identity and rank preservation
validate-only does not load Wiki-DPR or Generator

reproducibility.dataset_identity: nq_open validation fixed positions 1950, 1960, 1970, 1980, 1990 within validation[1950:2000]
reproducibility.environment: Record resolved Generator identity, config and plan hashes, Python, git revision, and selector allowlist.

limitations: This is an L0 diagnostic case study, not a population-level utility comparison.
Answer-string-in-text flags are proxies and must not be reported as strict gold passage alignment.
No conclusion about selector superiority or paper-level improvement may be drawn from five questions.
